title: Democrats Claim 56 Senate Seats After Mary Peltola Wins in Alaska
summary: Mary Peltola defeated Senator Dan S. Sullivan, a two-term incumbent, to become the first Democrat to represent the conservative state in the Senate since 2015.
body_markdown: Mary Peltola defeated Senator Dan S. Sullivan, a two-term incumbent, to become the first Democrat to represent the conservative state in the Senate since 2015.
